anti_drift_rules: NO_UNIVERSAL_TRIGGER_CHASE: Do not start V3/V4/etc merely to obtain rarer incidence.
NO_INCIDENCE_PROXY_OBJECTIVE: Lower incidence is not success; high incidence is not automatic failure.
MEMORY_NOT_SUCCESS_LABEL: Memory is a causal structural event, not success proof.
V2_NOT_EXIT_SIGNAL_YET: V2 stays descriptive until a later governed decision gate changes status.
NO_PREMATURE_ARBITER: No broad OR, weighted voting, hazard model, ML, or large arbiter before measurement is sound.
CONTEXT_NOT_EQUAL_VOTER: Regime/time/progress/giveback begin as context variables.
NO_MISSING_AS_NO_SIGNAL: Missing or invalid observations are not clean no-signal opportunities.
PRIMARY_LIFECYCLE_STOPS_AT_NATIVE_TERMINATION: Do not merge post-close counterfactual continuation into primary V2 analysis.
TERMINAL_TIME_FIREWALL: Do not bypass prohibited outcome fields for terminal timing.
NO_TUNED_HORIZONS: Do not choose horizon/timeout/lookback/reference refresh from favorable results.
NO_ECONOMICS_BEFORE_PHASE_F: No PnL, economic ranking, outcome-driven selection, or actual exit authority.
NO_PROTECTED_YEAR_REOPEN: This authority does not reopen protected-year economics or sealed data.
explicitly_rejected_question: Will V2 eventually appear if the price is watched long enough after the original lifecycle?
human_decision: Freeze the new multi-pattern exit-brain direction and roadmap so future work must resync against it whenever the project risks drifting back toward single-trigger chasing or premature complexity.

paths.meaning: Mandatory protection / acute adverse risk; not an equal vote beside ordinary detectors.
Before the predefined progress event, ask whether expected progress failed to confirm.
After the predefined progress event, study evidence that continuation is deteriorating; V2 lives here.

north_star.architecture_direction: Limited-complexity state-conditioned multi-pattern architecture: independent detectors + explicit event timing + context variables + later bounded rule-based arbitration only after distinct functions are proven.
north_star.goal: Build a causally observable, interpretable, adaptive multi-pattern spot exit brain that recognizes different legitimate ways a position may lose continuation validity across market conditions.
north_star.research_method: Test primitives independently for causal correctness and understanding, but never require one primitive to explain all exit modes.

primary_diagnostic_question: Within the original lifecycle, after first Memory, when does V2 appear before the position terminates natively, under known causal coverage and observation opportunity?
resync_instruction: Before every future exit-brain mission, compare the proposed task to this authority. If it conflicts with the North Star, anti-drift rules, roadmap position, or economics firewall, stop and explicitly resync before proceeding.

roadmap.gate: Every identity is accounted for exactly once; original and audited eligibility remain separate; missing/invalid observations are never treated as no-signal; NO_MEMORY is a result, not an exclusion.
roadmap.purpose: Reconcile all 153 canonical identities to the previously measured 33 without silent cohort redefinition.

roadmap.gate: Every Memory lifecycle has a defensible exposure interval and terminal classification.
roadmap.purpose: Separate no observed V2 from insufficient opportunity to observe V2.
roadmap.terminal_time_firewall: Do not read prohibited outcome exit_time implicitly; use an already-authorized causal runtime terminal event or obtain a separately scoped authorization.

roadmap.gate: Timing, support, reference age and dependence are reported without economic claims or tuned horizons.
roadmap.purpose: Explain V2 frequency in time and structure and expose shared-market clustering before interpreting decision relevance.
roadmap.reference_rule: Measure the frozen reference; do not refresh, replace, or tune it in Phase C.
required_outputs: descriptive competing-event cumulative incidence only if coverage permits
reference-age diagnostics across all Memory lifecycles

roadmap.purpose: Reconfirm or minimally revise the three functional paths against A-C evidence and current RD27 functions.

forbidden: Add a detector merely to lower V2 incidence.
roadmap.mandatory_precheck: Inspect existing RD27 Adaptive Stagnation before creating any new detector.

scientific_corrections.current_interpretation: V2 is frequent in the currently measured cohort. Its decision utility is unresolved. The 92% ever-fired incidence alone does not prove usefulness or failure because observation opportunity, native termination, timing, reference age, coverage, and market clustering have not yet been reconciled.
scientific_corrections.forbidden_old_interpretation: Do not say V2 failed merely because 23/25 Memory lifecycles eventually produced V2, and do not treat the 25/25 vs 23/25 difference as general proof of better selectivity.
scientific_corrections.memory: Memory means a predefined causal structural-progress event occurred. It is not proof that the trade was successful, profitable, or economically valid.
scientific_corrections.v2: V2 is the first strictly-later completed close below the frozen first-Memory breakout reference. It remains a descriptive post-progress structural event, not an exit signal and not yet weighted evidence.
